Offload repetitive business operations tasks to Claude Cowork
A commenter says a company trained over 300 companies to use Claude Cowork for repetitive business operations tasks, with teams adopting paid plans.
·
Oct 26, 2026
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
The source is a short Hacker News comment, not a walkthrough. The author says they know a company that trained over 300 companies this year to use Claude Cowork, mostly for business operations tasks. Users hand off boring, repetitive work to it. The comment gives no detail on specific tasks, setup, or workflow steps.
How it went
The commenter says adoption is sticking: most teams start on a free plan, and after about three months multiple people are on Teams plans. No task-level results or metrics are given.
Worth knowing
This is a secondhand anecdote with no specifics on tasks, costs, or time saved, so treat it as a signal of demand rather than a recipe.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Help me offload a repetitive task from my [role/team]: [describe the task, e.g. weekly invoice reconciliation from files in [folder]]. First ask me any questions you need, then do it for one sample batch using the files in [folder] and save the result as [format, e.g. spreadsheet] in [output folder]. Stop when the sample is done and show me the steps you followed so I can approve turning them into a repeatable routine.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50252386
